Mando VS Dragonsnake w/ Jon Favreau and Pedro Pascal | Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu
Go behind the scenes with Jon Favreau (Director/Writer/Producer) and Pedro Pascal (Actor, Din Djarin) as they break down the dragonsnake fight in the tank under the twins' Nal Hutta Palace. Favreau and Pascal discuss filming anecdotes, design inspiration from their love of past Star Wars projects, and Din's parental relationship with Grogu.
